## Type of change

- [ ] Monitored sites (`.upptimerc.yml` → `sites`)
- [ ] Status page settings (`.upptimerc.yml` → `status-website`)
- [ ] Theme or assets (`assets/`)
- [ ] Issue or PR templates, docs

## Checklist

- [ ] I didn't edit files in `.github/workflows/`. Upptime rewrites them from `.upptimerc.yml`, so manual edits get lost.
- [ ] I didn't edit `history/`, `api/`, `graphs/` or the README status table by hand. Upptime generates them.
- [ ] New or changed site URLs return a success status, ideally from a light health-check page.
- [ ] Site names are unique. Renaming a site changes its slug and starts its history from scratch.
- [ ] Theme changes look right in both light and dark mode, and on a phone.
